experiment: W17 episode column (O2 control/filtered vs banked b4 on the V1a 1,208-point cohort)

results.restraint: NO CHANGE: proposal rate ~99.5% on all three (b4 99.6%, control 99.5%, filtered 99.3%); the 58.8% noopFP defect persists identically in the RL arms
results.content: arm proposals deviate from b4 surface on most typing points (median difflib sim 0.56 control / 0.40 filtered; only ~17-22% near-identical); direction unknown without labels
results.caveat: per-proposal correctness is not derivable from episode labels (gt = user typing; accept/dismiss are reactions to b4-specific proposals); the both-order preference column (quota-gated) is the arbiter

verdict: INTERIM: RL arms show NO episode-restraint improvement; content shifts are unjudged. Intent/forgetting columns and the preference arbiter remain before any RL adoption recommendation - per the EV doc stop rule, an RL arm worse on restraint or felt acceptance halts the recommendation; restraint is already confirmed NOT improved, so adoption hinges entirely on the preference/intent columns.
